verdict.rationale: The quickstart documents official SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Go and Java, each with install/import lines and a full write/query sample. The official OpenAPI repo confirms that the TypeScript, Python, Go and Java clients (plus C# and Rust) are official and generated from the spec. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and a documented Java install/package coordinate (only an import line is shown).

support.subject: As a developer, I can build against official SDKs in the major languages (Python, TypeScript, Go, Java)

citations.quote: Each language carries a full write/query code sample in the quickstart.
its official TypeScript, Python, Go, Java, C#, and Rust clients are generated from the spec
